prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the mold from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Indoor lab bench scene. A white wall sign reads "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese text and a purple logo with a square fiducial marker; a black inverted-U metal frame stands below it.

On the left, two white plastic wash bottles stand upright on an aluminium extrusion bench, each with a red angled spout cap in place; one has a green stripe, the other a blue stripe. Both appear to hold clear or white contents.

Centre right: a smaller white squeeze bottle, upright and capped, about two-thirds full of dark teal/blue liquid.

To its right, a black rack holds four capped tubes with orange caps, empty-looking, on a raised aluminium frame. Metal fittings and a fiducial label sit on the bench front.
observations: The workbench photo shows wash bottles, a squeeze bottle, and a rack of capped tubes, but no mold is described anywhere on the bench surface.
